## Task: "Provide a way for model formsets to disallow new object creation" (Django ticket #31884)

**Cause:** `BaseModelFormSet` had no way to make a formset edit-only. `extra=0` doesn't help because bound formsets trust the POSTed `TOTAL_FORMS` count — extra forms injected via Javascript/POST data are treated as new-object forms and saved.

- `django/forms/models.py`
  - `BaseModelFormSet`: new class attribute `edit_only = False`; `initial_form_count()` and a new `total_form_count()` override return the queryset length only when `edit_only` is set, so no extra forms are ever constructed; `save_new_objects()` returns `[]` immediately when `edit_only` is set.
  - `modelformset_factory(..., edit_only=False)` — passes it through to `formset_factory`.
  - `inlineformset_factory(..., edit_only=False)` — passes it into the formset kwargs.
